'''Tarjan's algorithm''' may refer to one of several algorithms attributed to [[Robert Tarjan]], including:

* [[Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm]]
* [[Tarjan's off-line lowest common ancestors algorithm]]
* Tarjan's algorithm for finding [[Bridge (graph theory)|bridges]] in an undirected graph<ref>{{citation
 | last = Tarjan | first = Robert E.
 | title = A Note on Finding the Bridges of a Graph
 | journal = Information Processing Letters
 | volume = 2
 | issue = 6
 | pages = 160–161
 | url = https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/0020-0190%2874%2990003-9
 | url-access = subscription 
 | year = 1974
 | doi = 10.1016/0020-0190(74)90003-9
 }}</ref>
* Tarjan's algorithm for finding [[Cycle (graph theory)#Definitions|simple circuits]] in a directed graph<ref>{{citation
 | last = Tarjan | first = Robert E.
 | title = Enumeration of the Elementary Circuits of a Directed Graph
 | journal = SIAM Journal on Computing
 | volume = 2
 | issue = 3
 | pages = 211–216
 | url = https://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/0202017
 | url-access = subscription 
 | year = 1972
 | doi = 10.1137/0202017
 | hdl = 1813/5941
 | hdl-access = free
 }}</ref>
